crossRefs.note: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together and encamped in Gilead. The children of Israel assembled themselves…

crossRefs.note: The children of Israel traveled and came to their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, Chephirah…
The children of Kiriath Arim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred forty-three.
